sourceTitle: Sony venice 6k Full frame Cinema Camera ( arri Alexa mini )
sourceDescription: The ultimate high production cinema camera Sony venice in the starter set allowing for high quality recording with 4x 256gb SXS cards and other goodies for all kinds of mounts.

sourceTitle: Sony venice 6k full frame cinema camera
sourceDescription: This is the Sony venice beginner set that can be kitted out with acessories and Adonis available with us. It offers the camera body, with pl and ef mount and all lisences as well as power cable and d-box power distribution. This set is meant to compete with arri Alexa mini.

sourceTitle: Sony venice 6k Cinema ( arri Alexa mini ) + DZO Vespid set
sourceDescription: This is a great set to get started on everything Sony venice and comes ready to shoot with everything needed from raw storage to recorder, to tripod and media and the cinema lens set of 6 lenses going 16,25,50,75,100,125mm DZO VESPID PRIME lenses.
included: 6 lenses going 16,25,50,75,100,125mm DZO VESPID PRIME lenses

sourceTitle: DZO Vespid Prime Cinema lens set + Bmpcc 6k pro camera
sourceDescription: A full set consisting of everything needed to get started on a larger film production containing the DO Vespa cinema prime lenses in a full set arranging from 16 mm all the way to 125 mm and magic pocket cinema six pro camera in addition to one terabyte storage Five batteries and all needed boxes and adapters
